_meta.purpose: MISC Starlancer MAX ship + zone definitions.
_meta.axis_convention: Width = port-to-starboard (X). Length = ramp-end to forward (Y). Height = floor up (Z). All units are 1.25 m cubes; scu_capacity = width x length x height.
_meta.ramp_note: The Starlancer MAX loads via the rear; both bays use ramp_side='low_y' with ship_forward_y='high' so the rear/entry end renders at the bottom of the diagram.
_meta.layout_note: Forward bay = two columns F1/F2 (2 x 16 x 2 = 64 SCU each). Rear bay = side columns R1/R2 (2 x 8 x 3 = 48 SCU each) flanking the central Rear Bulk zone RB (2 x 8 x 2 = 32 SCU).
_meta.rb_note: RB (Rear Bulk) is the vehicle-bay floor used for bulk cargo. It is given the HIGHEST unload_priority so the planner only fills it as a last-ditch overflow zone, after F1/F2/R1/R2.
_meta.totals: Ship total = F1 64 + F2 64 + R1 48 + R2 48 + RB 32 = 256 SCU.
